name: CardMedia
need: The card had NO media slot at all: no image-top article card, no horizontal media card, no text-over-image cover — the whole visual half of content display. Every major system models this as slots on one card (Material media block, Fluent CardPreview + orientation, Ant cover, Polaris MediaCard, Fiori card shell).

consideredAlternatives.whyNot: Fluent proves top-vs-side is one orientation decision on one component; a second card is a second anatomy to keep true.
Media needs what content must not inherit: full-bleed against the padding, cover cropping, and the scrim — placed by hand it is wrong somewhere every time.

proposedApi.CardMedia: placement top | side | cover; tone brand | ink for photograph-less covers; children = the media. `cover` overlays the card's own content on the image and ALWAYS brings the scrim (--scrim-fade over the text band, --scrim-foreground text): text never sits on raw imagery.

sources: user's uui/grid-test reference (photo cards, tinted covers, horizontal cards); Material 3 / Fluent 2 / Ant / Polaris / Fiori research 2026-08-21; WCAG worst-point contrast + Material scrim guidance
decision: Build as a Card part with scrim tokens in primitives/semantic (theme-invariant: the image obeys neither theme).
decidedBy: owner (2026-08-21, approved the content catalogue plan)
